Booking App

The booking app validates authenticated hiring requests, stores their schedule and status, and restricts booking details to the owning user.

Application Configuration

Django application configuration for the booking domain.

Bases: AppConfig

Register the relocated booking app under its stable Django label.

Model

Database model for authenticated labor bookings.

class apps.booking.models.Booking(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: Model

Represent a scheduled request by one user to hire a laborer.

A booking records when and where the work should happen, its expected duration, customer notes, and the current workflow status. Deleting a user removes their bookings, while a referenced labor profile is protected from deletion.

Serializer

REST Framework serializer and validation for labor bookings.

class apps.booking.serializers.BookingSerializer(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: ModelSerializer

Serialize booking input and read-only labor/status information.

Clients select a laborer and submit scheduling details. The authenticated user, initial status, labor name, labor wage, and display status are controlled by the backend.

Create a pending booking for the authenticated user.

perform_create(serializer)[source]

Recheck labor availability and persist the user’s booking.

The availability check is repeated after serializer validation so the write path does not rely only on an earlier request-validation step.

Parameters:

serializer (apps.booking.serializers.BookingSerializer) – Validated booking serializer supplied by DRF.

Raises:

serializers.ValidationError – If the selected laborer is no longer available.
